digest.component_or_area: mutation gate selector / conftest support mapping
propositions: Recursive conftest glob in global_support causes all seven mutation shards to trigger on any nested conftest change, wasting runner time without loading affected fixtures
Runtime tracing proves pytest loads only six ancestor conftests per shard, not sibling fixture trees such as tests/external/live_jira_dc/conftest.py
Across 97 recent Verify runs, seven over-trigger candidates consumed 5.38 runner-hours without coverage gain
Exact per-shard conftest ancestry mapping aligns selector behavior with pytest's upward-only conftest discovery model
Contract test validates per-shard support lists exactly match derived ancestor conftests and fails on missing or stale dependencies
Unrelated nested conftest changes must select zero shards and each ancestor conftest must select only its dependent shards
